title: Dinesh Kumar Vishwakarma v. M.D. (Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitaran Khand) Agra
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip Gupta, J.; Jayant Banerji, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner left to clause 6.5 bill correction.
headnote: A consumer disputing electricity bills was relegated to clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench did not examine the bills and disposed of the writ, leaving that statutory correction remedy open.
facts: Dinesh Kumar Vishwakarma petitioned the Allahabad High Court disputing electricity bills issued by Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Khand, Agra. The Managing Director of the licensee and two others were impleaded. Counsel for the respondents submitted that the petitioner could seek correction of the bills under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court did not examine the bills or the underlying consumption dispute.

holding_units.holding: A writ disputing electricity bills was disposed of without examining the bills, leaving it open to the consumer to invoke clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 for correction of those bills.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the disputed electricity bills
not_decided.note: No examination of the bills or consumption; relegated to clause 6.5.
